info.name: CDB Appraisal PII API
info.description: POST /public/generate-credit-appraisal: multipart form field 'data' (JSON string, vendor's flat credit appraisal schema) + repeated 'file' parts for bank statement PDFs (filenames must match the keys in data.file_banks). Synchronous: mask PII -> forward to vendor (Azure AI Foundry) -> unmask response -> return finished appraisal. base_url defaults to the Docker Compose / nginx port (8080); switch it to http://127.0.0.1:8000 if running the app directly with uvicorn instead of docker compose.

variable.description: Set to the local path of BOC.pdf (repo root) after import: Body > form-data > file > Select File
Set to the local path of HNB.pdf (repo root) after import: Body > form-data > file > Select File

request.description: Field 'data' is Text (JSON string, matches examples/new_request_payload.json). Two 'file' parts, one per statement_1.pdf/statement_2.pdf (must match data.file_banks keys). After import, set statement_1_path/statement_2_path variables or re-select the files directly: Body > form-data > file > Select File (use BOC.pdf and HNB.pdf from the project root). Response returns { reference_id, status, result } where result is the vendor's generated appraisal with all PII unmasked.
Optional: re-fetch a completed result by reference_id (also returned inline by generate-credit-appraisal itself).
